baseline.note: Expected behavior comes from the verified static baseline/parity contract; this matrix records only current V2 source coverage and never converts source presence into runtime acceptance.

acceptanceRule: No row is PASS/ACCEPTED from source evidence alone. Hardware/media/runtime gates remain separate.

features.expected: UltraCar cockpit/home illustrated dashboard with V1 proportions/background/sidebar/shortcuts in DeX
features.gap: Home shell exists and no longer exposes invented RACING/Ultrabot click actions when V1 semantics are unverified. Original six governed media still require authorized private staging and screenshot parity remains unaccepted. On S10 Android 12 simulated displays (not Samsung DeX), 1280x720, 1600x900 and 1920x1080 pass task-affinity + non-flat 2D image gates after a fresh isolated QA launch. One previously reproduced grey screenshot (1 color) and a wrong-size screenshot are correctly rejected. Visual pixel parity with Golden V1 Build369, media rights, real OEM DeX and UVC remain unaccepted. 2026-11-17 real S10 QA: all 15 declared V2 Activity screens open and render nonflat images (15/15), and combined virtual-secondary-display Android instrumentation passes 46/46; screenshot hashes and full audit at tests/ultracarhcm-v2/ALL_SCREEN_REAL_S10_AUDIT_20261117.md. This is activity-start smoke ONLY, not individual V1 function acceptance or physical DeX/UVC/BT/Gear-R. F group state remains unchanged.
features.actual: HomeActivity renders the V2 cockpit shell with governed background/logo/vehicle resource references, clock, settings and shortcut grid. RACING is visual-only and Ultrabot is non-clickable decorative media so V2 does not fabricate actions that are not verified from V1. Independent Canvas road/vehicle fallback prevents flat SPORT art where licensed resources are not present, and the image gate measures and hashes actual secondary-display screenshots after verifying QA Activity placement and rollback.

features.expected: Vehicle card/model/color selection, parked/moving images and license plate
features.gap: Two verified source vehicle choices, local model/color selection and bounded license-plate display are implemented. Vehicle model plus legacy migration flag and license-plate changes now require synchronous persistence success before refreshing or acknowledging the UI. Full V1 branded card styling, moving-state behavior and real-media parity remain open.
features.actual: VehicleActivity lets the user choose between the two existing source vehicle choices (Limo đỏ and Lamborghini trắng) and store a bounded local license plate. It commits vehicle model plus the legacy limo migration boolean and commits the normalized plate before showing success; Home renders the selected parked vehicle plus the saved plate.

features.expected: Real USB Host UVC streaming, image controls and USB permission lifecycle
features.gap: Runtime CAMERA permission is a fail-visible gate before any UVC controller start; USB-device permission remains device-scoped in the UVC library. Bounded recovery is now fenced to the exact recovering USB device, so detaching an unrelated USB peripheral cannot cancel a still-attached camera retry. Real USB camera grant/preview/reconnect behavior still requires physical-device acceptance.
features.actual: UsbCameraActivity checks android.permission.CAMERA before calling UsbUvcController.start(), requests the Android runtime permission through the system prompt only, keeps denial visible, and allows the user to retry. UsbUvcController discovers USB video-class devices, requests device permission through the UVC library, opens preview, and performs bounded recovery for a still-attached device. Recovery tracks the exact deviceId being retried and only cancels that pending retry when the matching camera detaches; unrelated USB detach events leave the recovery generation intact.

features.expected: Separate camera window with manual open/close while preserving real camera video
features.gap: Separate window, manual toggle and display-affinity source exist; real USB video/device behavior and cross-display runtime acceptance remain unaccepted. Camera shortcut now closes/opens the popup itself (rather than only USB preview); external DeX launch bounds use the target-display density. Device DeX/window-placement QA still pending. 2026-11-17 real S10 QA: all 15 declared V2 Activity screens open and render nonflat images (15/15), and combined virtual-secondary-display Android instrumentation passes 46/46; screenshot hashes and full audit at tests/ultracarhcm-v2/ALL_SCREEN_REAL_S10_AUDIT_20261117.md. This is activity-start smoke ONLY, not individual V1 function acceptance or physical DeX/UVC/BT/Gear-R. F group state remains unchanged.
features.actual: UsbCameraActivity keeps same-display shortcut taps as a toggle, but when a camera window exists on another display it requests a dedicated camera task on the requested display and closes the stale window only after the display-specific launch succeeds.

features.expected: Reverse signal plus 0.5m/1.0m/1.5m parking guide activation and calibration
features.gap: V2 now has three distinct user-selectable, durable visual guide styles (Sport Racing/Luxury OEM/Minimalist Modern), labelled 0.5m/1.0m/1.5m guide curves, finite steering/warp/progress sanitization and real-device S10 Canvas rendering tests. Source requires actual USB frame AND verified reverseActive before drawing; it never invents a gear-R signal. 2026-11-17 S10 isolated QA: 24/24 instrumentation PASS, including 3 F05 Canvas/persistence gates + 3 F16 backup v6 gates, evidence SHA ADE067D69D6989E91A7A27F8B8176E1247D47E1D7FEC1541499D902839453812. Physical DeX/UVC/gear R, calibration, and exact V1 visual acceptance remain OPEN, so F05 stays PARTIAL_SOURCE.
features.actual: HomeActivity switches to a dedicated narrow DeX HOME panel only when its own desktop window is tall/narrow. The panel preserves V2 logo/background/clock/vehicle and bounded Google Maps, Camera USB and Settings actions without claiming control of other app windows. Existing reverse-guide source remains intent-fed and uncalibrated.

features.expected: Exactly one draggable transparent DeX Camera shortcut with the same action as in-app Camera
features.gap: Single transparent draggable shortcut plus explicit camera display-affinity source exist; DeX display routing still requires real-device QA.
features.actual: OverlayService creates one transparent draggable camera ImageButton on the resolved external display. UsbCameraActivity only reuses a camera already on that display, relaunches to the requested display when needed, and refuses an unspecified-display fallback if explicit display launch fails.

features.expected: DeX auto-launch, multiple displays, freeform windows, zone overlays and layout persistence
features.gap: Samsung DeX receiver validates real desktop/external-display state before acting. OverlayService keeps per-display coordinates durable, rolls canceled drags back, and now derives the 56dp shortcut size from the resolved target display context so pixel sizing/clamp do not inherit the phone/default-display density. OEM background-activity launch behavior, full zone orchestration and real-device acceptance remain open.
features.actual: DexUtils detects desktop/external displays; OverlayService resolves the target display, creates a target-bound display context before sizing the shortcut, then clamps/persists coordinates in that display's pixel space. ACTION_UP persists coordinates synchronously; ACTION_CANCEL restores the starting coordinates without a preference write. DexDockReceiver launches V2 Home only when a real external DeX display exists and ignores EXIT while external DeX is still active.

features.expected: Multi-zone/slot dashboard management with saved/default layouts and relaunch
features.gap: Local saved/default Home state is versioned and recovered safely. The HOME KHỞI ĐỘNG action performs a real device-local operation: it reapplies the default Home configuration when one exists, otherwise opens saved configurations, and gives an actionable save prompt when none exist. Five stable saved-layout shortcuts now follow the Owner-verified V1 placement contract with equal spacing and transparent cells between KHỞI ĐỘNG and the bottom actions; tap applies and long-press reassigns. User-visible save/apply/default/delete mutations require synchronous persistence success. Exact V1 shortcut icon artwork, full multi-zone orchestration, and real-device DeX acceptance remain open.
features.actual: HomeActivity saves/applies/removes versioned local Home configurations and assigns/migrates unique stable config IDs. KHỞI ĐỘNG is no longer a placeholder: startConfiguredHome reapplies the persisted default configuration, opens saved configurations when no default exists, or prompts the user to save one. Five saved-layout shortcuts use stable config IDs, equal-width spacing and transparent cell backgrounds; tap applies a saved layout and long-press reassigns it. Automatic recovery/normalization uses synchronous commit(), stale shortcut IDs are durably cleaned, and Schema-v5 backup/restore validates stable-ID shortcut references.

features.expected: Road/city/theme/day/night/video/custom image Home backgrounds
features.gap: Verified day/night backgrounds plus user-selected image/video backgrounds are implemented without broad storage permission. User-visible appearance changes now require synchronous preference persistence; custom-background replacement commits the new URI/kind before releasing the previous persisted URI grant, and clear commits preference removal before releasing the old grant. Exact V1 theme catalog/media parity and real-device video/background acceptance remain open.
features.actual: AppearanceActivity commits day/night mode before refreshing status. For a custom image/video it first acquires the new SAF grant, commits the new V2 background state, releases the new grant on commit failure when safe, and only after successful commit releases a different previous grant. Clearing a custom background commits preference removal before releasing the previous URI grant.

features.expected: Shortcut bar/map applications and bottom actions/image/music
features.gap: Nine assignable/launchable slots exist. The verified V1 bottom action row now preserves saved layouts/new layout/Camera semantics: the third action explicitly opens UsbCameraActivity while Ultrabot remains decorative media behind the transparent Camera action. Quick-slot writes are synchronously committed, malformed state is durably cleared, invalid package IDs are rejected, and an external-app launch race fails visibly instead of crashing Home. Exact V1 icon artwork and real-device Camera/DeX persistence acceptance remain open. Remote accessibility key capture now independently implements user-approved learn/select + hold-to-toggle real Camera popup + short media/volume replay with explicit Android Accessibility consent; source/JUnit and S10 local preference tests PASS. Physical Bluetooth steering remote compatibility and latency are still unaccepted. On actual S10 simulated secondary display 1920×1080, V2 QuickBar default Material3 white cards were objectively over-bright (57.08% near-white pixels in y56–78% vs 3.32% on auxiliary V1 Build362). Dark translucent cards reduce near-white fraction to 0.17%, preserve 9 click/long-click source callbacks, and existing 31/31 Android instrumentation tests pass. This is a UI appearance-only regression fix; physical DeX, individual nine-slot click/long-press interactions and Golden Build369 exact visual parity remain NOT ACCEPTED.
features.actual: QuickBarGrid renders exactly nine assignable slots; long press assigns/removes presets or validated package targets and click launches package/camera targets. Resolved external app launches are guarded so uninstall/disable/OEM-policy races show an actionable toast instead of crashing Home, with no fabricated install fallback. The Home bottom row includes saved layouts, new layout and an explicit transparent CAMERA action that launches UsbCameraActivity while preserving Ultrabot decorative media. saveQuickSlot commits bounded JSON synchronously before success. Compose QuickBar now uses bounded compact dark cards, subtle cyan border/icons and ellipsized text, retaining the existing nine slot assignments, click and long-press handlers.

features.expected: GPS, battery/weather/telemetry and diagnostics zone
features.gap: Real Android battery and foreground GPS diagnostics are implemented in source; weather provider, full V1 telemetry presentation and real-device location acceptance remain open. 2026-11-17 real S10 QA: all 15 declared V2 Activity screens open and render nonflat images (15/15), and combined virtual-secondary-display Android instrumentation passes 46/46; screenshot hashes and full audit at tests/ultracarhcm-v2/ALL_SCREEN_REAL_S10_AUDIT_20261117.md. This is activity-start smoke ONLY, not individual V1 function acceptance or physical DeX/UVC/BT/Gear-R. F group state remains unchanged.
features.actual: TelemetryActivity reads sticky Android battery state, requests foreground fine/coarse location permission, shows the freshest last-known GPS/network location and requests one fresh fix from an enabled provider. Weather is explicitly left unconnected until a verified V1/provider contract exists.

features.expected: OBD/Bluetooth pairing, speed/rpm/battery and diagnostics
features.gap: Paired-device selection, RFCOMM OBD session and speed/RPM/adapter-voltage parsing are implemented in source. Connection lifecycle tracks both published and in-flight sockets, fences stale generations and marshals UI handoff through lifecycle guards. The external Bluetooth-pairing Settings launch now fails visibly instead of crashing if an OEM cannot resolve or rejects the intent. Actual adapter pairing/connection, vehicle compatibility and real telemetry acceptance require device/vehicle QA.
features.actual: ObdActivity opens system Bluetooth settings for pairing through a guarded fail-visible helper, lists bonded devices with BLUETOOTH_CONNECT permission, connects by RFCOMM SPP, publishes a socket only after initialization succeeds, and keeps the in-flight candidate separately cancellable so reconnect/stop/destroy cannot leave a stale blocking connect ahead of the next single-threaded session. It closes stale/failed candidates, guards generation/lifecycle transitions, and only starts telemetry after a guarded UI-thread connected transition. ObdProtocol parses speed, RPM and voltage without claiming V1 UI parity.

features.expected: Taxi meter, trip distance/time/rates/history/revenue
features.gap: Foreground GPS trip distance/time, Owner-configured rate, local trip history and revenue are implemented in source. Rate, completed-trip history and explicit history deletion require synchronous persistence success before UI acknowledgement. Fare calculation reuses the bounded rate invariant and rejects non-finite or Long-overflow computed fares instead of saturating. Persisted history requires exact numeric scalars, a positive timestamp, nonnegative duration/distance, an in-range rate and a recorded fare that exactly matches the canonical calculation; reads are capped at MAX_HISTORY, invalid/excess rows are synchronously cleaned, and revenue aggregation saturates instead of overflowing. Real-device GPS accuracy, V1 tariff semantics/UI parity and long-trip behavior are not accepted.
features.actual: TaxiMeterActivity tracks foreground-only elapsed time and GPS distance, uses only an explicit Owner-entered VND/km rate, commits the rate before starting, and commits bounded history before saved acknowledgement. TaxiMeterRules centralizes exact scalar parsing, fail-closed fare overflow handling, validPersistedTrip and nonnegative saturating addition; TaxiMeterActivity sanitizes JSON-valid but semantically invalid/excess history before rendering/export and prevents revenue overflow. No V1 tariff is guessed.

features.expected: Profile, identity/license, greeting and registration/extension
features.gap: The verified V1 V66 original Profile-header subtitle behavior is reflected in V2: real installed V2 version/build appears directly under the Profile title in red, with no floating version badge. Driver-name edits from both Profile and Home now require synchronous persistence before UI acknowledgement/rerender. Identity/license backend, registration/extension, remaining exact V1 card styling and real-device Profile acceptance remain unverified and are intentionally not fabricated. 2026-11-17 real S10 QA: all 15 declared V2 Activity screens open and render nonflat images (15/15), and combined virtual-secondary-display Android instrumentation passes 46/46; screenshot hashes and full audit at tests/ultracarhcm-v2/ALL_SCREEN_REAL_S10_AUDIT_20261117.md. This is activity-start smoke ONLY, not individual V1 function acceptance or physical DeX/UVC/BT/Gear-R. F group state remains unchanged.
features.actual: ProfileActivity renders the runtime V2 version/build as the red header subtitle at the original Profile location, keeps version/update actions inside normal cards rather than a floating badge, and edits the same device-local driver display name used by Home. Profile and Home driver-name mutations commit synchronously and surface storage failure. License/registration remains fail-closed until a verified backend contract exists.

features.expected: User/notification tabs and independent update checking
features.gap: Kênh V2 TEST vẫn fail-closed cho tới khi có APK V2 TEST ký số được phát hành. Metadata phải khớp exact schemaVersion=1, channel=ultracarhcm-v2-test và packageName=ai.tigeriq.ultracarhcm.v2 trước khi được render/tải; signed APK tiếp tục phải qua SHA-256 + package + exact versionCode + exact versionName + signer pin/continuity trước Android installer. Async metadata/download work được fenced theo live UpdateActivity generation. Publication signed APK, device installation acceptance, remote push/backend và exact V1 notification parity còn mở.
features.actual: ProfileActivity tách CẬP NHẬT và THÔNG BÁO. UpdateActivity chỉ nhận canonical V2 TEST metadata khi UpdateRules xác minh strict scalar types và exact schema/channel/package identity; sai hoặc thiếu identity bị từ chối trước render/download. Candidate APK sau đó chỉ đi qua bounded trusted redirect chain, fsync cache, SHA-256/package/exact versionCode/exact versionName/certificate + signer continuity, rồi mới bật Android system installer. Metadata/download callbacks mang operation generation và từ chối stale/destroyed UI handoff; stale verified APK bị xóa.

features.expected: Backup/export/import/restore all user settings/images/layout/shortcuts/sound/vehicle with security-bound exclusions
features.gap: Versioned backup schema v6 now exports and validates the V2-owned Camera guide style and snapshots/restores that preference domain with synchronous commit and rollback; legacy v1-v5 backups keep the currently selected style untouched. On S10 isolated QA, full 24/24 Android Instrumentation PASS including three new real-device guide-style round-trip/legacy/invalid-input tests; evidence SHA ADE067D69D6989E91A7A27F8B8176E1247D47E1D7FEC1541499D902839453812. Existing Home/quick slots/saved layouts/vehicle/overlay/Taxi backups remain. V1 media and sound/feature data, cross-device provider-bound background grants and complete feature parity still remain unaccepted; F16 stays PARTIAL_SOURCE.
features.actual: Schema-v5 restore: HomeActivity xuất schema v5 qua SAF và validate đầy đủ trước mutation. Trước restore, V2 chụp snapshot Home, saved-layout shortcuts, overlay và Taxi Meter theo đúng domain cần thay. Mỗi domain commit() đồng bộ; nếu một commit thất bại, rollbackRestoreAndFail() khôi phục snapshot theo thứ tự Taxi → overlay → shortcut → Home, ghi lỗi nếu rollback không hoàn tất và không báo restore thành công. Legacy schemas vẫn không phá các field mới; không đọc/ghi V1, credential hay broad storage.

features.expected: Language/theme/appearance/color palettes
features.gap: Appearance now has a dedicated surface for the verified day/night mode and custom user media; V1 language mapping and color-palette semantics are still unverified and intentionally not invented.
features.actual: Home settings opens AppearanceActivity. It changes the existing day/night preference and manages user-selected custom image/video backgrounds while explicitly leaving language and V1 palette parity open.

features.expected: Administrative/licensing/customer activation/device registration where legitimately available
features.gap: A real V2 administrative/license status surface now exists, but it is deliberately read-only and fail-closed because no verified V1/backend contract for customer activation, license extension or device registration is available. Actual backend integration and runtime acceptance remain open.
features.actual: ProfileActivity opens AdminLicenseActivity, which shows the installed V2 package/version/device model and explicitly reports license backend, customer activation and device registration as unavailable until a verified contract exists. It performs no network call, collects no credential and exposes no activation/registration mutation.

features.expected: Data export/reporting sheets where supported by V1
features.gap: A dedicated V2 report hub summarizes V2-owned Taxi Meter trip count, distance, duration and recorded revenue and exports CSV through Storage Access Framework. Malformed JSON is fail-visible and synchronously cleared. JSON-valid rows with wrong numeric types, out-of-range rates, invalid timestamps/distance/duration or a fare inconsistent with the canonical calculation are excluded; reads are capped at MAX_HISTORY and the cleaned history is synchronously persisted. Exact V1 XLS/report templates, dashboards and other feature-domain exports remain unverified and are not claimed.
features.actual: ProfileActivity opens ReportActivity, which reads at most TaxiMeterRules.MAX_HISTORY V2 Taxi Meter rows, uses exact scalar parsing and validPersistedTrip to reject semantically invalid rows, synchronously cleans rejected/excess rows, shows aggregate trip/revenue/distance/time with saturating report totals and exports stable UTF-8 BOM CSV through user-selected SAF. It requests no broad storage permission and exports no credentials or V1 data.

features.expected: Permissions for camera/USB/geolocation/overlay/update package/privacy/error recovery
features.gap: Runtime source có fail-visible CAMERA gate, location/Bluetooth/overlay state và package-install channel dựa trên V1 V69 nhưng hẹp hơn: signed APK phải qua metadata/hash/package/exact versionCode/exact versionName/signer verification trước; FileProvider chỉ lộ cache updates; unknown-sources và Android installer confirmation là bắt buộc. Các đường mở Android app-details/overlay settings từ Privacy và Home đã fail-visible nếu OEM không resolve hoặc từ chối intent. Privacy-policy parity và full real-device validation vẫn chưa nghiệm thu.
features.actual: UsbCameraActivity chỉ khởi động UVC sau CAMERA runtime grant; PrivacyActivity hiển thị permission state và mở OS settings qua guarded external-intent helper; Home overlay-permission action dùng cùng fail-visible contract thay vì crash khi Settings intent lỗi. UpdateActivity tải candidate vào cache riêng, giới hạn redirect/size, kiểm SHA-256, ZIP/package/exact versionCode/exact versionName, signer pin + signer continuity, rồi dùng FileProvider mở Android system installer. Không broad storage, shell, ADB hay silent install.

features.expected: Responsive portrait/phone/landscape/DeX two/three-column profile cards without clipping
features.gap: Profile source now reflows one/two/three columns by width for compact phone, landscape/tablet and wide DeX, but exact V1 card styling and real-device clipping acceptance are still open. 2026-11-17 real S10 QA: all 15 declared V2 Activity screens open and render nonflat images (15/15), and combined virtual-secondary-display Android instrumentation passes 46/46; screenshot hashes and full audit at tests/ultracarhcm-v2/ALL_SCREEN_REAL_S10_AUDIT_20261117.md. This is activity-start smoke ONLY, not individual V1 function acceptance or physical DeX/UVC/BT/Gear-R. F group state remains unchanged.
features.actual: ProfileActivity groups local profile, runtime version/update, fail-closed identity/license status, and V2 trip reporting into responsive cards. ProfileLayoutRules uses 1 column below 600dp, 2 columns at 600–959dp and 3 columns at 960dp+; Android recreation on configuration changes rebuilds the layout.

features.expected: Crash/restart, offline/backups, migration, coexistence, signing and rollback
features.gap: Local migration/recovery and schema-v5 backup source now preserve bounded V2 Taxi Meter history plus five stable-ID Home saved-layout shortcut assignments while keeping schemas 1–4 backward readable. Actual signed release provenance, downgrade/rollback execution and real-device recovery acceptance remain open. 2026-11-17 real S10 QA: all 15 declared V2 Activity screens open and render nonflat images (15/15), and combined virtual-secondary-display Android instrumentation passes 46/46; screenshot hashes and full audit at tests/ultracarhcm-v2/ALL_SCREEN_REAL_S10_AUDIT_20261117.md. This is activity-start smoke ONLY, not individual V1 function acceptance or physical DeX/UVC/BT/Gear-R. F group state remains unchanged.
features.actual: V2 has an independent package, lifecycle/UVC cleanup, versioned Home-state migration and a bounded SAF backup envelope. Schema-v5 restore validates shortcut references against the imported saved-config set before writes and replaces only the V2 shortcut mapping; legacy backups remain readable without inventing shortcut data. RecoveryActivity reads real installed package/version/current signing identity; no installer protections are bypassed.
